name: gacha-tracker
description: Cross-game gacha progress, build, and daily tracker with Discord bot + reminders.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @gacha/web && npm run build -w @gacha/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @gacha/shared && npm run typecheck -w @gacha/server && npm run typecheck -w @gacha/web
scripts.db:sqlite: node scripts/gen-sqlite-schema.mjs && prisma db push --schema prisma/schema.sqlite.prisma --accept-data-loss
